locator: 1901 Census, Table I, p. viii, grand total; Newfoundland Historical Statistics (1994), Table A-1, footnote 2 for dates
method: Linear interpolation by elapsed days (784/913), rounded once. Uses the June 1 historical reference-day convention reported by the Newfoundland Statistics Agency. Original comparative table identifies census years. Both totals include the Labrador area in the historical returns.
